title: "Join the Lab"

# Join the Roylawar Plant–Microbiome Research Laboratory

We welcome enthusiastic students, researchers, and collaborators who are passionate about plant science, microbiology, molecular biology, and sustainable agriculture.

Our laboratory provides an interdisciplinary research environment integrating molecular biology, microbiology, plant pathology, bioinformatics, and microbiome science.

---

# Research Opportunities

We are interested in mentoring students and researchers working in:

- 🌱 Plant–Microbiome Interactions
- 🦠 Rhizosphere Microbiology
- 🧬 Molecular Plant Biology
- 💻 Bioinformatics
- 🧪 Metagenomics
- 🌾 Sustainable Agriculture
- 🧅 Allium Biology
- 🦠 Biological Control
- 🌍 Microbial Ecology

---

# Ph.D. Students

Highly motivated students interested in pursuing doctoral research are encouraged to contact the laboratory.

Prospective students should have an academic background in:

- Botany
- Microbiology
- Biotechnology
- Molecular Biology
- Agriculture
- Life Sciences

---

# M.Sc. and B.Sc. Research Projects

The laboratory regularly offers dissertation projects and research internships for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

Students gain hands-on experience in:

- Molecular Biology Techniques
- Microbial Isolation
- DNA & RNA Extraction
- PCR and qPCR
- Metagenomics
- Bioinformatics
- Plant Pathology
- Scientific Writing

---

# International Collaborations

We encourage collaborations with researchers, universities, and research institutes working in:

- Plant–Microbiome Research
- Sustainable Agriculture
- Microbial Ecology
- Functional Genomics
- Plant Health


---

# What We Expect

Successful applicants are expected to demonstrate:

- Scientific curiosity
- Strong work ethic
- Teamwork
- Critical thinking
- Good communication skills
- Commitment to research integrity

---

# How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to send:

- Curriculum Vitae (CV)
- Academic transcripts
- Brief statement of research interests
- Contact details of academic referees (if available)

to the Principal Investigator.
